name: Koa Health Perspectives
one_liner: Koa Health guided CBT app for a range of mental health conditions, listed by Koa as coming soon and not yet available.
best_for: Adults whose provider or organization adopts Koa Perspectives once it launches
People who want app-based guided CBT
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
Anyone who needs help now: it is not yet available
People without access through a provider or organization
short_description: Guided CBT app that Koa Health says is in development; it is listed as coming soon on Koa's product pages.
long_description: Koa Perspectives is an app Koa Health says is being developed to provide guided cognitive behavioral therapy across a range of disorders. As of this review, Koa lists it as coming soon, with no launch date, price or access details. Koa sells its products to organizations and providers rather than to individuals. No published study of Perspectives was found.

pricing.notes: Koa lists Perspectives as coming soon; no price published.

privacy.notes: Koa's privacy policy could not be opened for this review; the App Store label lists health, contact and usage data linked to you and declares no tracking.
